transcript.text: My Shark cordless battery got really hot on charge last night and this morning it looks puffed up, the plastic case has split at the seam a bit. Can I still use it till a new one comes? It's the IZ201UK.
First, let’s look at what the battery is doing. On a full charge, does it run only a short time before stopping, or will it not charge at all?

It does charge, but the runtime had dropped to maybe 10 minutes before this. Last night it got really hot on charge and the battery LEDs flashed oddly. It's still clicked into the vacuum, charger unplugged now. There's also a bit of a chemical smell near it this morning, and it's leaning against the kitchen cupboards next to the tea towels.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
If you can smell gas, treat it as an emergency: don't turn any switches on or off and no naked flames. Turn the gas off at the meter if you safely can, open doors and windows, and leave if the smell is strong. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.
